name: Nifco Inc.
summary: Nifco Inc. manufactures and sells industrial plastic parts and components in Japan, Asia, North America, China, South Korea, the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company offers driver assistance systems, exterior, interiors, power train, and engine/fuel/transmission products for automobile; and products for motorcycle. It also offers household equipment, such as drawer closers, push latches, earthquake-proof latches, and door dampers; consumer electronics/office automation products that include dampers, free-stop hinges, push latches, and one-way clutches; and fashion/sport products, such as side release buckles, cord locks, and other buckles.
